audit_F.purpose: Spot-check other fields (description, unit) on 20 random codes to detect collateral damage from policy re-extraction
audit_F.notes: Unit column is NULL for ALL 12,460 rows (verified via COUNT query). This is a pre-existing schema state, not damage from policy extraction. All 20 sampled DB descriptions are consistent with the canonical Indian ITC 8-digit schedule for their codes. Note: pdftotext -layout suffers from column-staggering on multi-line cells in the chapter PDFs; some DB descriptions appear at a different visual row than their code in raw PDF text. Where discrepancies appeared in raw text, the DB value matches the canonical WCO/ITC subheading semantics, so the apparent mismatch is a PDF-extraction artifact rather than a DB error.
